tool_args.rationale: The target horizon is 22.2, while all five observations have H ≤ 0.48. The slow-horizon probe directly constrains the proposed slow adaptation and reversal before fitting the five parameters.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the sink-coupled dual-horizon model from the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The short horizons leave the slow adaptation timescale and long-horizon reversal poorly identified.
Additional short-horizon resolution would not directly resolve the target-horizon ambiguity.
The supplied co-activation guidance favors a sink-coupled adaptation mechanism; a long-horizon observation can test its reversal.
